message.reasoning: We need to answer based on policy excerpts. The user asks: "Not sure if closed tickets are even in scope for an export." They want to know if closed tickets are included in export. According to DOC-018 part 1: "A standard export from the dashboard includes every record in the current view, including archived and closed ones, unless a filter on the export screen narrows it to a status." Also note that the active queue view hides closed records but export filter is independent. So answer: Yes, closed tickets are included by default unless you filter them out. Provide short answer.

function.arguments: {"message":"Yes—by default a standard export includes all records in the current view, even archived and closed tickets. Only if you apply a status filter on the export screen will closed tickets be excluded."}
